先看最难的一段，再看风景: Start with the hardest section, then the scenery
这三场不是可以互换的「轻松散步」。Ravenswood 地形较平，活动仍长约三英: These outings are not interchangeable easy walks. Ravenswood is relatively level but still covers about three miles; El Corte de Madera is a multi-hour forest loop; Mount Umunhum has the shortest distance but many stairs. With children, older companions or limited recent exercise, compare the hardest section first. Photos and a family-friendly label are not enough, and meeting at the summit does not mean hiking there from the foothills.

集合点比保护区名字更重要: The meeting point matters more than the preserve name
一座保护区可能有多个相距很远的入口。编辑建议出发前把单场页的集合点保存到导航，再: A preserve may have widely separated entrances. Save the event’s meeting point, then check the lot name and final approach. Skeggs Point is on Skyline Boulevard’s east side and prohibits a left turn from the north; this Ravenswood outing meets at the end of Bay Road; Mount Umunhum meets at summit parking. Do not accept the first result for the preserve name, and separately check whether the last leg is feasible by public transport.
免费项目仍有参加流程: Free outings still have participation procedures
Midpen 导览免费，参加者需在集合点签署声明。单场若要求预约，必须照报名规则: Midpen’s guided outings are free and require a waiver at the meeting point. Follow event-specific booking instructions where required; no reservation button does not remove check-in. Groups of eight or more should contact staff first. Dogs may join only specifically labeled dog outings, and independent walks still follow each preserve’s own rules.
当天缩短或取消，也可以是好安排: Shortening or canceling can be the right plan
没有哪张十一月活动表能提前保证晴天、鸟类出现或步道干燥。官方说明大雨可能取消导览: A November listing cannot guarantee sunshine, bird sightings or dry trails. Heavy rain may cancel guided hikes and lighter rain may change the route; recheck event and closure notices. Bring water, layers and suitable shoes rather than relying on supplies in the hills. Ravenswood has no restrooms, so plan ahead. An easy meal afterward is a more flexible editorial suggestion than adding another distant long hike.
